name: Silvermoon City
shortDescription: Silvermoon City, a Burning Crusade setting in the Shattered Sun research story.
body: The blood-elf capital where Kael'thas returns before turning his design toward the Sunwell. This story uses original interpretive TBC-era city art; the scene is not a literal layout reconstruction. Geography remains at region scale until original-client comparison.
